title: Uncertainty Quantification in the Tsetlin Machine
new_feature: A probability score P(y=1|x)=(1+v/T)/2 derived from the Type I/II feedback equilibrium of the TM class sum, plus a normalized multiclass variant, used for uncertainty quantification and selective prediction.

datasets.notes: Class-sum convergence studied; no accuracy reported (Fig. 1). T=2000, s=1.0, 20 clauses.
